analysis: The closest option covers international governance, strategy, transnational law, marketing and leadership. Accounting and financial markets give a stronger business core than rhetoric, and Qualitative Research Methodology adds primary qualitative research beyond general social psychology. Marketing, product design and market research form a concrete market-facing strand. Leadership work covers motivation, organisational culture, negotiation and the effects of pressure on decisions. Quantitative methods connect economics, econometrics and predictive models to evidence-based business decisions.

The digital option combines programming, data preparation, relational databases and algorithms with modelling and neural networks. AI Ethics addresses fairness and accountability. Business and Economy in the Age of AI and Strategy and Digital Transformation connect computation to decisions about organisations and markets. Transnational Business Law adds cross-border regulation and digital trade rather than generic behavioural context.

The finance option gives priority to international macroeconomics, banking, valuation, trade and empirical modelling. Probability, statistics and econometrics support analysis of risk and economic outcomes. Cross-border law, EU institutions, public economics and policy analysis give substantive institutional context. The finance plan replaces AI and generic digital courses with trade, markets and policy while retaining programming and data methods for analysis.

Pairwise differences are 60, 60 and 52.5 EC each way. The broad option prioritises leadership, consumer design and research, the digital option prioritises systems and AI, and the finance option prioritises risk, trade and policy. No extra option is required. Supply chain management, firm location and multinational finance remain distinct. The accounting match addresses financial statements, and the strongest finance match addresses valuation and market risk. Groningen integrates other competencies in separately credited courses.
constructionStop: Three coherent, distinct options reach the programme limit.
